Source assessment: Read the complete current claim, whole associated semantic_spec.rs, the sole implementation association, and sole test sage_meta::todo::modules_parse_recovery_completeness. The claim requires terminal error items/error CST nodes for this parse, conservative incompleteness of the surrounding represented set for exhaustive consumers, and no conclusive absence unless error irrelevance to that question is proved. All remain covered by the explicit deferral of uniform question-sensitive completeness; retained errors alone do not establish this guarantee. The implementation TODO names that missing prerequisite. The empty annotated TODO test calls for malformed and unsupported-item fixtures preserving safe sibling symbols and rejecting false exhaustive negatives attributable to missing constructs. It contains no behavioral assertions: terminal error handling, incompleteness propagation, and the question-relative irrelevance exception remain unverified. Completing those tests requires a question-sensitive completeness result and downstream consumers that preserve it; any future definitive-negative case must establish irrelevance or exhaustive input. The existing TODO accurately accounts for this gap, so no change to its deferred classification is needed.

Baseline: independently verified exact byte equality of the current semantic_spec.rs against both historical implementation_sources and test_sources; claim and implementation metadata match. The historical test source is now a separate fragment; the test identity, cfg, status and body are unchanged. Reassessed the historical rationale against current evidence rather than treating its verdict as implementation proof. No production helper is relied on to assert implemented behavior.

Execution: personally ran review start with the supplied instructions, review read for the review policy, and exact-source comparison scripts. No functional tests or build were run by this reviewer; coordinator-reported 321 passing tests and cargo build are separate execution evidence and do not discharge these TODOs. This report accepts documented deferral only, not completed implementation or test coverage.
